legal_citation: Muhammad Abbas v. Federation of Pakistan & FIA (W.P. No. 27854/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger suspected of seeking unauthorized economic opportunities abroad; travel to Africa on visit visa deemed high-risk.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held offloading illegal and unconstitutional under Article 15. A citizen with valid visa, return ticket, and funds cannot be stopped on vague apprehensions.

legal_citation: Tariq Mahmood v. Director General FIA (W.P. No. 19402/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Fresh passport to Dubai without conventional corporate employment letter; freelance bank statements deemed unconvincing.
judicial_verdict_summary: Court set aside offloading. Freelance digital workers with valid international client contracts and verified liquidity cannot be treated as irregular laborers.

legal_citation: Sobia Khan v. Federation of Pakistan (C.P. No. D-4819/2023, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Solo female traveler on fresh passport; officer questioned absence of accompanying male guardian (non-statutory condition).
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC sternly reprimanded immigration counter officers. No law requires male accompaniment for adult female travelers with valid foreign visas.

legal_citation: Malik Rizwan v. FIA Immigration (W.P. No. 31045/2024, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Traveler failed verbal grilling on hotel location; counter officer suspected hidden intent to seek blue-collar work in Kuala Lumpur.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held that memory lapses regarding hotel street names do not constitute statutory grounds to cancel travel where confirmed voucher exists.

legal_citation: Dr. Arshad Begum v. Ministry of Interior (W.P. No. 1120/2023, Islamabad High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Officer demanded Protector Stamp despite the doctor presenting a short-term conference business visa, confusing it with medical overseas employment.
judicial_verdict_summary: IHC ruled that Protector Stamp applies strictly to Emigration/Employment visas under Emigration Ordinance 1979 Section 15, not business conference visas.

legal_citation: Hassan Raza v. State (W.P. No. 24890/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Young male traveler on fresh visit visa to Bangkok suspected of being lured by Southeast Asian cyber-trafficking hubs.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC observed that generalized advisories regarding Bangkok/Cambodia transit do not authorize blanket bans on genuine leisure travelers holding confirmed return flights.

legal_citation: Farooq Ahmed v. Federation (C.P. No. D-2910/2024, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Officer suspected passenger was traveling to Qatar on visit visa to convert to work permit without Bureau registration.
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC quashed the offloading order and reprimanded the shift in-charge. Lawful departure on a valid visit visa with return ticket cannot be blocked on presumptive future visa changes.

legal_citation: Zubair Shah v. FIA (W.P. No. 14210/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger unable to show traditional salary slips; regional profiling of traveler from KP heading to Baku.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held that digital earnings substantiated through banking channels meet financial criteria. Regional origin cannot be used as an illicit risk factor.

legal_citation: Naveed Akram v. Ministry of Interior (W.P. No. 3450/2023, Islamabad High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Officer alleged Departmental NOC was missing, despite petitioner presenting sanctioned ex-Pakistan leave notification.
judicial_verdict_summary: IHC ruled that sanctioned ex-Pakistan leave issued by the competent authority satisfies departmental NOC requirements.

legal_citation: Imran Baloch v. FIA (C.P. No. D-1550/2024, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Small-scale merchant traveling to Yiwu questioned over lack of formal corporate chamber membership.
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC affirmed that individual commercial traders with valid business visas and supplier invitations cannot be barred merely for lacking large chamber registration.

legal_citation: Usman Tariq v. DG FIA (W.P. No. 8920/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Officer suspected bank employee planned to hunt for jobs in Dubai banking sector while on tourist visa.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held that subjective speculation of job-seeking intentions without tangible illegal act violates constitutional freedom of travel.

legal_citation: Bilal Vohra v. FIA (C.P. No. D-3341/2023, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Exhibition badge name showed minor typographic spelling difference compared to official CNIC.
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC quashed offload, ruling that minor clerical misspellings on trade passes do not invalidate genuine corporate identity.

legal_citation: Ayesha Siddiqui v. Federation (W.P. No. 12904/2024, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Officer claimed Turkey is a major transit route to Greece, suspecting illegal human smuggling trajectory.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC ruled that legitimate professional women traveling on certified vacation leave cannot be profiled based on geographical transit routes.

legal_citation: Khurram Parvez v. FIA (W.P. No. 2099/2023, Islamabad High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Counter officer alleged remote work is not recognized as a legitimate livelihood proof for international travel.
judicial_verdict_summary: IHC affirmed that remote digital marketing constitutes recognized lawful livelihood under modern jurisprudence.

legal_citation: Saeed Anwar v. FIA (W.P. No. 17743/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Heightened scrutiny advisory on Kyrgyzstan following student unrest; officer barred all departures.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held that country advisories do not empower FIA to halt lawful business travelers with verified commercial counterparties.

legal_citation: Farhan Qureshi v. Federation (C.P. No. D-4122/2024, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Low balance in personal bank account deemed insufficient by counter officer despite holding $1,500 cash endorse.
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC ruled that physical foreign currency endorsement meets financial sufficiency criteria under FIA published rules.

legal_citation: State v. Akram Masih (FIR No. 112/2023 FIA Anti-Human Trafficking Circle Lahore)
officer_stated_grounds: Departure on employment visa without Protector Stamp issued by Bureau of Emigration is strictly prohibited under Emigration Ordinance 1979 Section 15.
judicial_verdict_summary: Statutory offload upheld. Section 15 of Emigration Ordinance 1979 mandates that no citizen may depart for foreign employment without Protector registration.

legal_citation: State v. Muhammad Asif (FIA Counter Record, Islamabad Airport 2024)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger presented direct work visa without protector clearance; visa agent bypassed official registration channels.
judicial_verdict_summary: Lawful offload affirmed. Unprotected labor migration leaves workers vulnerable to wage theft and contract substitution abroad.

legal_citation: State v. Zafar Iqbal (FIA AHTC Sialkot Airport Record 2023)
officer_stated_grounds: Missing protector stamp on work visa. Recruited via unregistered sub-agent.
judicial_verdict_summary: Mandatory offload under Emigration Ordinance 1979. Protector verification required before international boarding.

legal_citation: State v. Rashid Ali (FIA Immigration Karachi Airport 2024)
officer_stated_grounds: Absence of Protector of Emigrants endorsement.
judicial_verdict_summary: Mandatory administrative offload under statutory mandate.

legal_citation: State v. Tanveer Hussain (FIA Counter Record Peshawar Airport 2023)
officer_stated_grounds: Missing protector stamp on valid work visa.
judicial_verdict_summary: Statutory requirement non-compliant; departure denied.

legal_citation: State v. Gulzar Ahmed (FIR No. 89/2023 FIA Passport Circle Karachi)
court_or_agency: Special Court (Offences in Respect of Banks/FIA)
officer_stated_grounds: Counterfeit Schengen visa sticker detected under UV/magnification inspection; forged bio-data page.
judicial_verdict_summary: Conviction under Passport Act Section 6 for using fraudulent travel documents.

legal_citation: State v. Shahid Mehmood (FIA AHTC Case No. 45/2024 Multan)
officer_stated_grounds: Fake return ticket barcode and counterfeit hotel confirmation voucher.
judicial_verdict_summary: Document fraud detected at counter screening.

legal_citation: State v. M. Rafiq (FIA IBMS Alert Case No. 901/2023 Lahore Airport)
officer_stated_grounds: Active Exit Control List (ECL) notification issued by Ministry of Interior in pending banking fraud NAB inquiry.
judicial_verdict_summary: Mandatory interdiction under Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance 1981.

legal_citation: State v. Tariq Javed (FIA Immigration Islamabad 2023)
officer_stated_grounds: Missing protector stamp on valid employment visa.
judicial_verdict_summary: Statutory departure rule enforced.

legal_citation: National Assembly Standing Committee Inquiry into Greece Boat Disaster (Report 2023)
court_or_agency: National Assembly of Pakistan / FIA AHTC
officer_stated_grounds: Unemployed youth holding one-way visit visa to Benghazi without hotel booking or return ticket, organized by illicit human smuggling syndicate.
judicial_verdict_summary: FIA interdiction of unlawful sea-crossing transit scheme under Anti-Human Trafficking Act.
governing_statutes: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018

legal_citation: National Assembly Inquiry into Cambodia Scam Compound Trafficking (FIA Briefing 2024)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger holding visit visa to Phnom Penh but found in possession of crypto-scam employment contract; one-way ticket funded by offshore operator.
judicial_verdict_summary: Interception of illicit cyber-fraud trafficking recruitment.
governing_statutes: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018

legal_citation: FIA Special Operation on Turkey-Greece Balkan Route (FIA Circular 2023)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger admitted during counter interview to paying Rs. 1.2M to an agent in Gujrat for illegal crossing into Greece via land border.
judicial_verdict_summary: Interdiction of human smuggling facilitator network.

legal_citation: FIA Sialkot Airport Inquiry into UAE Visit Visa Labor Smuggling (2024)
officer_stated_grounds: Dummy return ticket canceled 1 hour prior to flight; passenger possessed physical overseas employment agreement with Dubai catering firm.
judicial_verdict_summary: Unregistered labor emigration disguised as visit visa; statutory offload under Emigration rules.

legal_citation: FIA Islamabad Airport Inquiry on Senegal Transit Route (2023)
officer_stated_grounds: No return ticket, no hotel booking; destination Senegal used as stepping stone for clandestine boat departure to Spain Canary Islands.
judicial_verdict_summary: Irregular migration channel interdicted.
governing_statutes: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act 2018

legal_citation: State v. Babar Ali (FIA Karachi Airport Counter Record 2024)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger possessed work contract for Malaysian palm oil plantation while traveling on e-visa; lacking protector registration.
judicial_verdict_summary: Clandestine labor departure interdiction.

legal_citation: FIA Sialkot Counter Crackdown on Iraq Pilgrimage Transit (2023)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger possessed unauthorized employment letter for Basra oil contractor while traveling on pilgrimage visa group without return ticket.
judicial_verdict_summary: Unauthorized labor migration interdicted.

legal_citation: M. Jibran Nasir v. Federation of Pakistan (C.P. No. D-3412/2023, Sindh High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Name placed on internal agency stop list / Provisional National Identification List (PNIL).
judicial_verdict_summary: SHC declared offloading without judicial or statutory ECL order illegal, unconstitutional, and ordered immediate removal from PNIL.
governing_statutes: Constitution Art. 15 & 10-A, Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance 1981

legal_citation: Ahmad Bilal v. Ministry of Interior (W.P. No. 16504/2023, Lahore High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Passenger shared identical name with an individual wanted in a customs inquiry in Quetta.
judicial_verdict_summary: LHC held that secondary CNIC biometric verification should have cleared the identity mismatch; offloading an innocent namesake is unlawful.

legal_citation: Salman Farooq v. Federation (W.P. No. 4201/2024, Islamabad High Court)
officer_stated_grounds: Phonetic similarity with ECL record from 2018.
judicial_verdict_summary: IHC quashed offloading. Identity verification requires CNIC cross-matching, not arbitrary halt on phonetic common names.
